summary: Sporting News' running tracker of MLB free agency rumors, signings and trades after the 2023 Winter Meetings, with entries dated Dec. 8 to Dec. 23. The biggest items are Shohei Ohtani's $700 million Dodgers deal, Yoshinobu Yamamoto's $325 million Dodgers contract, and the Tyler Glasnow trade and extension. It also covers many mid-tier signings and the market for Cody Bellinger and Blake Snell.
one_line: Sporting News tracker of 2023 MLB offseason moves after the Winter Meetings, led by Ohtani and Yamamoto signing with the Dodgers.
key_facts: Shohei Ohtani agreed to a 10-year, $700 million contract with the Dodgers on Dec. 9, a record for total value and average annual value; he will defer $680 million, receiving $2 million per year, with $68 million per year from 2034-43.
Ohtani's deal counts as $46 million annually toward the Dodgers' luxury tax thresholds.
The Dodgers reportedly signed Yoshinobu Yamamoto to a 12-year, $325 million deal, the largest MLB contract for a pitcher, surpassing Gerrit Cole's deal with the Yankees by $1 million.

The Dodgers acquired Tyler Glasnow and Manuel Margot from the Rays for RHP Ryan Pepiot and OF Jonny Deluca, then gave Glasnow a five-year, $135 million extension with no deferred money that could reach $145 million with a $30 million option.

The Padres signed Japanese reliever Yuki Matsui to a five-year, $28 million deal with opt-outs in Years 4 and 5; he had 236 saves and a 2.40 ERA in 659.2 innings with the Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles.
The Giants signed Korean outfielder Jung-Hoo Lee to a six-year, $113 million contract with an opt-out after 2027; Lee is 25 and batted .340 in the KBO.
Cody Bellinger's agent Scott Boras is reportedly seeking well over $200 million, and the Cubs and Blue Jays were reported as favorites.

The Royals signed Seth Lugo (3 years, $45 million), Michael Wacha (2 years, $32 million), Hunter Renfroe (1 year, $5.5 million), and Will Smith (1 year, $5 million), bringing commitments to $82 million.
Lourdes Gurriel Jr. re-signed with the Diamondbacks for $42 million over three years, with a fourth-year club option and an opt-out after year two.
The Pirates added Martin Perez (1 year, $8 million), Rowdy Tellez (1 year, $3.2 million), and Andrew McCutchen (1 year, $5 million).
Jack Flaherty signed a one-year, $14 million deal with the Tigers after a 4.99 ERA over 27 starts in 2023.

The Giants were notified they were out of the Yamamoto bidding on Dec. 21, and the Angels discussed Blake Snell, as Yamamoto met with the Mets, Yankees, Giants, Phillies, Red Sox, Blue Jays and Dodgers.
The Giants agreed to a two-year, $8 million contract with catcher Tom Murphy, which could squeeze out Joey Bart, who is out of minor-league options.
The Red Sox acquired OF Tyler O'Neill from the Cardinals for pitching prospects Nick Robertson and Victor Santos.
